$comment: The model-free deterministic title (backend utils/conversations/deterministic_minimum.py: first sentence of the space-joined, whitespace-collapsed transcript, cut to 60 code points on a word boundary, no ellipsis). Clients use it as the last-resort title for a legacy row the server left untitled. `expected_title` null means the transcript yields no title; the server then uses its time label (`Recording · 3:14 PM`), which is not under this contract because it depends on the user's zone.
